Name: Animated Fairies
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
Bring a touch of magic to your farm with this mod. This mod lets you decorate with any of the vanilla fairy designs. You can, but absolutely do not need to, install both versions.

[b][size=3]✧ Furniture Framework ✧ [/size][/b]
Grab a Fairy catalogue from Robin's and take home an endless supply of fairy magic! These glowly fairies can be rotated in either direction, just like other furniture! You can also turn the light on and off, so these are very customizable!

[b][size=3]✧ Alternative Textures ✧ [/size][/b]
You can apply animated fairy textures to craftables and place them where ever you want!
[list]
[*]Lamps: When applied to lamps, the fairies glow, illuminating your farm with a soft, magical light. [/*]
[*]Scarecrows: Fairies love to bless crops, so this is just another reason to keep them in your field! (still works like a scarecrow, no light)[/*]
[/list]
To customize the appearance of your lamps & scarecrows with fairies, use the Paint Bucket tool, available for purchase from Robin. This allows you to switch between the design options.

Install to let your farm sparkle with the magic of fairies!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/21811/21811-1772230399-1592457206.gif[/img]

[b]Texturable Craftables:[/b]
[list]
[*]Scarecrow[/*]
[*]Deluxe Scarecrow[/*]
[*]Iron Lamp-post[/*]
[*]Wood Lamp-post[/*]
[/list][b]Texturable Furniture:[/b]
[list]
[*]Classic Lamp[/*]
[*]Country Lamp[/*]
[*]Modern Lamp[/*]
[*]Ornate Lamp[/*]
[*]All Wall Sconces[/*]
[/list]
Certain lamps will have different light qualities, like Lamp-posts which have a glowing aura. 
Using wall sconces gives you light at night, with the fairies acting more like stickers on the wall.
Scarecrows do not glow at all (and can be placed inside!) if you don't want any glow.

[size=3][b]✧ Translators (Please Give Them Kudos!) ✧[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]de/Deutsche Übersetzung von [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/LucyTheDove/about-me]LucyTheDove[/url]![/*]
[/list][i]Send me your translation file via DM using [url=https://smapi.io/json/i18n/]https://smapi.io/json/i18n/[/url] to be considered for inclusion![/i]
